name: app-shater-service-listing-phone-on-dark-stone-pile
title: Shater craftsman service-listing screen on a phone resting among dark grey stones
whatItIs: A moody black-and-grey photo of jagged stones with a phone propped among them showing the craftsman's 'الخدمات' (Services) screen: a search bar, popular-service filter chips, and job cards with descriptions, price offers and action buttons.
whatItMeans: Rugged and grounded; the stone setting matches the trade (construction/repair) the app serves.
techniques: Match the mockup's material to the app's industry.
Desaturate the scene so the phone screen stays legible.
Prop the phone naturally rather than floating it.

vocabulary.definition: A device shown resting on a physical object rather than floating.
A small toggle for narrowing a list.
